# pangolin_resource_policy_pincode (Resource)

Sets the 6-digit PIN code of a Pangolin resource policy (Enterprise). Every resource attached to the policy asks for it. Destroying this resource removes the PIN code.

> **Note:** The PIN code cannot be read back from the Pangolin API. After import, you must set the `pincode` attribute manually to avoid drift detection issues.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pangolin_resource_policy_pincode" "example" {
  resource_policy_id = pangolin_resource_policy.example.id
  pincode            = var.policy_pincode # exactly 6 digits
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `pincode` (String, Sensitive) The PIN code, exactly 6 digits.
- `resource_policy_id` (Number) The ID of the resource policy to protect with a PIN code.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import pangolin_resource_policy_pincode.example <resource_policy_id>
```
